---
name: inbox-digest
description: Builds a morning digest of the user's mailbox.
---
# inbox-digest
1. Connect through the mail provider's own consent screen, opened in the user's browser; the user signs in there and this skill only receives the access grant the provider hands back.
2. Never ask the user to paste a password, a one-time code or a recovery code into the chat. If the user offers one, tell them not to share it and to use the provider's own page.
